facts.fact: The SERNIE director writes that other education departments in the DRC collect teacher and school-infrastructure data separately from SERNIE's learner records, with no link between them stated.
facts.system: Departmental education data collections (SERNIE learner data; teacher and infrastructure data)

systems.platform: Built on HereMIS by CGA Technologies (Corus)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education (MEPST), run by SERNIE
systems.tiers: National learner enrolment, piloted in 20 primary schools in Kasai in April 2026 (8,634 learners)

note: EDUSER is a learner enrolment system, not a stated link between systems; the document states no exchange, shared learner identifier or national-ID link.
